resource: spell words range: players on the caster's floor within the CHAT-0 say range receive spell_words
unit: tiles from the caster (8 on x, 6 on y)
allocation_impact: No allocation: the spell_words event goes only to players on the caster's floor within ±8 x ±6 tiles, using the VIS-2 interest index, whether or not they hold CHAT_V1. Players farther away receive nothing.
boundary_tests: max=8 x 6: a player 8 tiles east and 6 tiles south of the caster on its floor receives spell_words (SPELL-PRESENT-1 emission test)
max+1: a player 9 tiles east, or 7 tiles south, or on another floor receives none (SPELL-PRESENT-1 emission test)
consumers: SPELL-PRESENT-1 spell words emission (not yet composed)
notes: SPELL-PRESENT-0 §6 and §13 (CHAT-0 say range). The row carries the x extent; the y extent is 6. Registered by PRESENT-WIRE-1 (MAGIC-CAST-1, #1622).
